{{Top|leg}}
A '''g-lock''' was a safety mechanism that was a common component of [[Acceleration strap/Legends|acceleration straps]] aboard [[Starship/Legends|spacefaring vessels]]. In instances when a vessel accelerated, decelerated or did anything else that caused a sudden change in momentum, a g-lock would react by tightening the restraints of a seat.
